aros_guide.text: Welcome to the Aros Centre. Aros means a dwelling in Gaelic. We tell the story of Skye here, with history, music and legends.
Skye has a Gaelic college, Sabhal Mòr Ostaig, in Sleat. It opened in 1973 and teaches in Gaelic.
The Old Man of Storr, the rock pinnacle you can see from Portree, stands about 50 metres tall. It is what is left of a huge landslip.

aros_fiddler.text: Skye is a fiddle island. Nobody has a quiet kitchen party. Come back after dark and bring your dancing feet.
